description: Lists the data Signal8 Pro covers beyond SplitScanner: insider trades, institutional ownership, congressional and executive-branch trades, campaign finance, analyst ratings and price targets, earnings and financial statements, market movers and the premarket scanner, intraday bars, news and clinical trials. Returns each data set with a one-line summary, the Signal8 MCP server address (same account as SplitScanner) and the upgrade link. Static, with no company lookup; available to every signed-in account, with no plan needed.
name: get_signal8_pro_coverage
title: Signal8 Pro Coverage
